ORIGINAL ISSUE: taiwan_civil_iot: SensorThings endpoint times out from Taiwan too — service moved or down, and TLS verification is disabled in the collector
## Why this matters

`taiwan_civil_iot` is broken for everyone, not just from abroad: `https://sta.ci.taiwan.gov.tw/STA_WaterResource_v2/v1.1/Datastreams` times out on all three attempts from a US runner (2026-08-12) **and from a Taiwan connection (maintainer-verified, 2026-08-13)**. The SensorThings service appears to be down or moved.

A second defect surfaced during verification: the collector ships with **TLS verification disabled** for this host ("TLS verification DISABLED for base_url=..." in the log). That is the workaround #169 exists to eliminate; whatever fix lands here should use the CA-bundle approach from #169 instead of `verify=False`.

## What to build

1. Find where the Civil IoT water-resource SensorThings service went. The Civil IoT Taiwan platform (ci.taiwan.gov.tw) has reorganised before; check the current data platform docs for the STA v2 successor.
2. Update the base URL and any payload changes.
3. Replace the disabled TLS verification with the shared TW GCA root bundle from #169 (coordinate if that lands first).
4. Verify live from a Taiwan connection or note that the reviewer must.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live fetch returns records again
- [ ] No `verify=False` remains for this host
- [ ] PR documents the new endpoint
- [ ] `pytest` + `ruff check` green

ISSUE TITLE: taiwan_civil_iot: SensorThings endpoint times out from Taiwan too — service moved or down, and TLS verification is disabled in the collector
ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
## Why this matters

`taiwan_civil_iot` is broken for everyone, not just from abroad: `https://sta.ci.taiwan.gov.tw/STA_WaterResource_v2/v1.1/Datastreams` times out on all three attempts from a US runner (2026-08-12) **and from a Taiwan connection (maintainer-verified, 2026-08-13)**. The SensorThings service appears to be down or moved.

A second defect surfaced during verification: the collector ships with **TLS verification disabled** for this host ("TLS verification DISABLED for base_url=..." in the log). That is the workaround #169 exists to eliminate; whatever fix lands here should use the CA-bundle approach from #169 instead of `verify=False`.

## What to build

1. Find where the Civil IoT water-resource SensorThings service went. The Civil IoT Taiwan platform (ci.taiwan.gov.tw) has reorganised before; check the current data platform docs for the STA v2 successor.
2. Update the base URL and any payload changes.
3. Replace the disabled TLS verification with the shared TW GCA root bundle from #169 (coordinate if that lands first).
4. Verify live from a Taiwan connection or note that the reviewer must.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live fetch returns records again
- [ ] No `verify=False` remains for this host
- [ ] PR documents the new endpoint
- [ ] `pytest` + `ruff check` green

ISSUE TITLE: taiwan_civil_iot: SensorThings endpoint times out from Taiwan too — service moved or down, and TLS verification is disabled in the collector
ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
## Why this matters

`taiwan_civil_iot` is broken for everyone, not just from abroad: `https://sta.ci.taiwan.gov.tw/STA_WaterResource_v2/v1.1/Datastreams` times out on all three attempts from a US runner (2026-08-12) **and from a Taiwan connection (maintainer-verified, 2026-08-13)**. The SensorThings service appears to be down or moved.

A second defect surfaced during verification: the collector ships with **TLS verification disabled** for this host ("TLS verification DISABLED for base_url=..." in the log). That is the workaround #169 exists to eliminate; whatever fix lands here should use the CA-bundle approach from #169 instead of `verify=False`.

## What to build

1. Find where the Civil IoT water-resource SensorThings service went. The Civil IoT Taiwan platform (ci.taiwan.gov.tw) has reorganised before; check the current data platform docs for the STA v2 successor.
2. Update the base URL and any payload changes.
3. Replace the disabled TLS verification with the shared TW GCA root bundle from #169 (coordinate if that lands first).
4. Verify live from a Taiwan connection or note that the reviewer must.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live fetch returns records again
- [ ] No `verify=False` remains for this host
- [ ] PR documents the new endpoint
- [ ] `pytest` + `ruff check` green

ISSUE DESCRIPTION:
## Why this matters

`taiwan_civil_iot` is broken for everyone, not just from abroad: `https://sta.ci.taiwan.gov.tw/STA_WaterResource_v2/v1.1/Datastreams` times out on all three attempts from a US runner (2026-08-12) **and from a Taiwan connection (maintainer-verified, 2026-08-13)**. The SensorThings service appears to be down or moved.

A second defect surfaced during verification: the collector ships with **TLS verification disabled** for this host ("TLS verification DISABLED for base_url=..." in the log). That is the workaround #169 exists to eliminate; whatever fix lands here should use the CA-bundle approach from #169 instead of `verify=False`.

## What to build

1. Find where the Civil IoT water-resource SensorThings service went. The Civil IoT Taiwan platform (ci.taiwan.gov.tw) has reorganised before; check the current data platform docs for the STA v2 successor.
2. Update the base URL and any payload changes.
3. Replace the disabled TLS verification with the shared TW GCA root bundle from #169 (coordinate if that lands first).
4. Verify live from a Taiwan connection or note that the reviewer must.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Live fetch returns records again
- [ ] No `verify=False` remains for this host
- [ ] PR documents the new endpoint
- [ ] `pytest` + `ruff check` green
